title: Boon for motorists: P16.80/L price rollback for gasoline
summary: The price of gasoline will drop by double digits for the first time since the start of the Middle East conflict in February, with local oil firms set to implement a rollback of P16.80 per liter…

blocks.text: The price of gasoline will drop by double digits for the first time since the start of the Middle East conflict in February, with local oil firms set to implement a rollback of P16.80 per liter effective today, Nov. 10.
